input_format: mode byte; bit 3: one DATA payload; bits 4/5: padded/invalid single DATA; bit 6: two DATA payloads with bits 4/5 selecting padding on first/second; bit 7: single DATA END_STREAM; then HPACK trailer block, except mode 0x88 plus 0xff marker and one byte inserts another DATA frame after END_STREAM
configuration_profile: real HTTP/2 upstream response trailer parser with a synthetic established response context
allocator_mode: fresh request pool and parser state for each input
justification: NGX-IF20 tests outgoing response trailers. This target covers the distinct HTTP/2 proxy-upstream receive path, including trailer validation and END_STREAM requirements.
state: The fuzz-only hook optionally prepends one or two DATA frames, including padded, deliberately invalid padding, or END_STREAM cases, then builds a HEADERS frame and optionally a CONTINUATION frame around the input HPACK block. A special mode 0x88 marker can instead insert a second DATA frame after END_STREAM. It initializes an active upstream stream and calls ngx_http_proxy_v2_process_frames, consuming each valid DATA payload and padding as the upstream body-filter caller does before resuming. No socket or upstream peer is used.
known_limitations: The response status and response-header phase are modeled as already complete; only a short synthetic DATA preamble is covered, not the full DATA/body lifecycle.
Stream ID is fixed to the active upstream stream. Frame types are generated by the hook to keep this target focused on trailer parsing.

The fuzz entry point asserts acceptance and one recorded trailer for canonical literal and CONTINUATION blocks, and rejection for canonical pseudo-header, bad-index, missing-END_STREAM, and frames following DATA END_STREAM cases; arbitrary mutated inputs are checked for sanitizer failures only.

scopes.contract: Decode trailer HEADERS/CONTINUATION frames for an established upstream response, reject invalid pseudo-fields and missing END_STREAM, and record accepted fields in upstream.headers_in.trailers.
scopes.preconditions: Fresh pool, active upstream stream ID 1, initialized trailers list, and response status already set to 200.
testcase_fields: END_STREAM flag on trailers or DATA
one or two DATA payload bytes
variants: valid trailer after DATA and CONTINUATION
padded DATA with one padding byte
padded DATA with excessive padding length
padded DATA END_STREAM followed by trailers
